[EN] You're empty-handed. That's not a good sign.
[ES] Vienes con las manos vacías. Eso no es una buena señal.

[EN] We didn't learn anything from her, except maybe about this "Dakuryon," whoever that is.

But on the bright side, we've stopped a leak, and they won't be able to spy on us that way again.
[ES] No aprendimos nada de ella, excepto tal vez sobre este "Dakuryon", sea quien sea.

Pero por el lado positivo, hemos detenido una filtración y ya no podrán espiarnos de esa manera.
